prompts.blazefang: Use case: stylized-concept, reference-guided character revision. Create ONE standalone concept portrait of MEGA BLAZEFANG for Wildbond, fully visible head-to-tail with generous clean margins on warm off-white paper, landscape 1536x1024 preferred. Do NOT redraw a four-panel family sheet. Exact title at top: MEGA BLAZEFANG. Small subtitle: ULTIMATE FORM CONCEPT. Image1 is our current Cindercub family board: the bottom-left normal adult Blazefang establishes the original WOLF identity, anatomy and mature face. Image2 is the user's Mega Charizard X reference: borrow the dramatic normal-to-ultimate color transformation and black/icy-blue/blue-fire contrast ONLY, never its dragon anatomy, wings, pose or head. Design a spectacular original FOUR-LEGGED apex wolf, not Charizard in wolf costume. Show a strong three-quarter full-body view facing right in a poised forward-driving stance, long mature canine muzzle, narrow intense glacier-blue eyes, charcoal pointed ears, strong jaw and elegant ivory fangs. Transform the ordinary warm brown/orange/cream Blazefang into an obsidian-black and deep cobalt creature with a broad silver-white chest and muzzle, luminous icy-cyan forehead blaze following the old orange blaze's shape, crisp blue highlights along the flank and bold cyan-blue inner ear panels. Its ultimate shoulder ruff expands into two great swept-back crescent mane blades made from attached deep-blue fur and AZURE FIRE, white-hot cyan at their roots and cobalt at tips. The crown frames the head and shoulders dramatically while keeping the head/ears clear; it is a flame mantle, not literal wings. Broad powerful forepaws with ivory claws, dark organic fur/scute-like ridges and thin blue fire seams concentrated at wrists/shoulders. Lean athletic hindquarters, long sweeping tail ending in three clear black-to-blue flame plume lobes, cool blue fire issuing cleanly from the cheek/neck ruff and tail, no orange flames anywhere. Keep body and all FOUR feet visible; no fire cloud hiding anatomy. Ultimate transformation should feel imposing, noble, loyal and fierce, with a new high-contrast palette and strong silhouette worthy of a late-game power. Clean expressive monster-anime concept art, confident dark outlines, large controlled cel-shaded shape clusters, matching the family board finish. No biped, human hands/clothing, mechanical armor, random glyphs, extra heads/limbs, horned demon, bat wings or direct Charizard features. No stats, types or claims of new gameplay abilities. The existing approved family images are reference only and must remain untouched.
prompts.tidewyrm: Use case: stylized-concept, reference-guided Mega character revision. Create ONE standalone concept portrait of MEGA TIDEWYRM for Wildbond, complete head-to-tail including all wing tips and feet with generous margins on warm off-white paper, landscape 1536x1024 preferred. Do NOT redraw the four-panel family board. Exact title: MEGA TIDEWYRM. Small subtitle: TIDAL WINGS CONCEPT. Image1 is our Ripplet family sheet. Its bottom-right Mega establishes the mature river-dragon face, gold eyes, yellow cheek landmark, cream underside, midnight-blue/teal body, blue-white fin crest, FOUR LEGS and three-pronged hydrofoil tail. Preserve those excellent original family identities. The user's requested change is dramatic WATER WINGS for the Mega only. Show the same fierce mature four-legged dragon, three-quarter view facing right, standing proudly with ALL FOUR limbs clear beneath a long muscular low reptilian body. TWO LARGE SYMMETRICAL TIDAL WINGS unfurl from the upper back behind the shoulders: each is an anatomical dark-blue branching FIN FRAME supporting a translucent turquoise water-like fin membrane that curls along the top like a cresting wave, with clean white foam tips and a few droplets at the edges. Their high arched silhouette suggests immense water power; maintain a connected shoulder/back root, not detached waves or a floating ring. They are sweeping dragon-fin wings formed like moving water, NOT feathered bird wings and NOT generic flat bat wings. Keep the adult tapered muzzle, angular cream jaw, narrow golden eyes, sharp brow fins and flowing neck crest; focused dignified expression. Strong navy/teal with pale icy-blue wing translucency and crisp white accents. A single sweeping dorsal crest and trident tail support the wing silhouette without cluttering it. Do not obscure the face/body/feet with splashes. Powerful, graceful, elemental and clearly a transformed final evolution, not a new species. Same clean monster-anime concept illustration treatment, strong outlines and controlled cel shading as the reference. No extra heads, humanoid posture, metal armor, random jewels/glyphs, overly long serpentine neck or extra wing-arms replacing the legs. No stats, new typing, flying field abilities or gameplay claims. All approved base/middle/final and Mosshog designs stay unchanged; this is a standalone optional Mega refinement.
